div.p: Row-Level Security on all tables · JWT carries tenant claim app.tenant_id set per DB session · Startup assertion verifies isolation

g.title: - /auth/login - /intakes (upload) - /reviews (queue, detail, finalize) - /search, /cases - /templates (CRUD, blank PDF) - /admin (wipe, reprocess) - /scalar/v1 (API docs)
- RLS on all 7 tables - pgvector (HNSW index) - pg_trgm (GIN indexes) - FTS (tsvector) - Append-only extraction_attempts - Audit events with correlation IDs
